text: Jody Messina flips a coin and it lands on Heads. Where's she going? Heads Carolina. Yes! Should have been a cowboy. Toby Keith said that California is full of three, what three things? Whiskey, women, and gold. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah! Oh, yes. George Stratts said that she can hang his note in a picture frame above what? Mantle. Mantle. Mantle. Mantle. Yeah! That's two! Any man of mine. Shania says you gotta shimmy, shake, and what else? Shake, let the heart break. Let the earthquake. Let the earthquake. Let the earthquake. I said heartbreak.
